description: The user's Movie and TV Diaries, newest first: every film and show they watched (or queued), what the movies and tv pages list. kind movie, tv or all; status watched (default), want_to_watch or all; from/to inclusive YYYY-MM-DD in the account timezone (To Watch rows have no date, so a range leaves them out); query matches title and notes; limit (default 50, max 200) with offset, has_more and next_offset. Each row: watch_id (for update_movie_watch, update_tv_watch, delete_movie_watch, delete_tv_watch), kind, title, year, watched_on, rating, season, episode, notes, visibility, poster_url. total counts every match. ($0.05; API key required)

query.description: Words in the title or notes.

name: get_watch_history

items.description: watch_id, kind, title, year, slug, status, watched_at, watched_on, rating, season, episode, notes, visibility, poster_url, title_url.

title: Get Watch History
